rdap_registration_dates.sql: SELECT lower(`ldhName`) AS domain, substr(e.`eventDate`, 1, 10) AS registered FROM pricise_rest.rdap_woot LATERAL VIEW explode(events) AS e WHERE e.`eventAction` = 'registration' UNION ALL SELECT lower(`ldhName`), substr(e.`eventDate`, 1, 10) FROM pricise_rest.rdap_walmart LATERAL VIEW explode(events) AS e WHERE e.`eventAction` = 'registration' UNION ALL SELECT lower(`ldhName`), substr(e.`eventDate`, 1, 10) FROM pricise_rest.rdap_amazon LATERAL VIEW explode(events) AS e WHERE e.`eventAction` = 'registration'
